purpose: Demonstrate a case-routing workflow to a steering committee
intended_outcomes: Reduce avoidable hand-offs without weakening decision authority or public-record controls.
non_goals: Approving production network access or security control policies independently
data_boundary: Generated records only; no customer or personal information.

decision_rights.decision: Outcome prioritization and discovery budget approval
Operating workflow acceptance and fallback validation
Security policy exceptions and formal control decisions
Technical evidence generation and bounded prototype execution

escalation_paths.topic: Sponsor pressure to deliver production data access or live environments
Conflicting requirements between Operations fallback demands and automation-first logic
Unclear legal compliance boundaries regarding public-record controls
